NONE: › a person who knows a lot about and is very interested in a particular subject
愛好者
› to rub an object made of metal, wood, or leather in order to make it shine, using a soft, dry cloth
（用軟布）擦亮
› (of) a pale, yellowish-brown colour
淡黃褐色的，米色的
› If a man is buff, he has a body that is a good shape, and looks as if he has done a lot of exercise.
（看似因做了許多運動而）體型健美的

example: He was spotted on the beach looking extremely buff.
他在海灘上出現，身材看上去十分健美。

NONE: › a large animal of the cattle family, with long, curved horns
水牛；野牛

C: › [ C ] something or someone that helps protect from harm
緩衝物；起緩衝作用的人
› [ C ] the metal parts at the front and back of a train or at the end of a track, that help protect the train and reduce damage if the train hits something
（火車的首尾或軌道末端的）減震器，緩衝器
C or U: › [ C or U ] a chemical that keeps a liquid from becoming more or less acidic

C: › [ C ] an extra supply of materials that a company keeps in order to prevent a situation where none are available
› [ C ] UK old-fashioned a silly old man

T: › [ T ] to provide protection against harm

I or T: › [ I or T ] When a computer buffers information or buffers, it stores information temporarily in its memory while dealing with it or sending it.

example: I bought a house as a buffer against inflation.
我買了一幢房子以緩解通貨膨脹帶來的影響。

NONE: › a peaceful country between two larger countries, that reduces the chances of war between them
（處於兩大國間、有助於緩解戰爭摩擦的）緩衝國
› an area intended to separate two armies that are fighting
（軍事）緩衝區
› a meal where people serve themselves different types of food
自助餐
› UK a restaurant in a station, where food and drinks can be bought and eaten
（車站的）餐館，速食部
› (of wind, rain, etc.) to hit something repeatedly and with great force
（風、雨等）連續猛撃，打撃

example: Are you having a sit-down meal or a buffet at the wedding?
你辦婚禮想擺桌宴還是提供自助餐？
The little boat was buffeted mercilessly by the waves.
海浪無情地拍打著小船。

NONE: › a carriage on a train where food and drinks can be bought
（火車上的）餐車
› a person who does silly things, usually to make other people laugh
